goal: Read, spell, and use words with *-ly* and *-er/-or*; return to the water cycle topic from 5.01 with more depth (states of matter, evaporation, condensation); last phrase-cued session — the markup fades starting next session.
newToday: suffix *-ly* (turns a word into an adverb — "in this way") and suffix *-er/-or* (turns a verb into "a person/thing that does it," or makes an adjective mean "more"). Tier-2 words: *transform*, *invisible*.
